settings.body: Two spirits, one philosophy. Hand-picked grapes from sun-warmed Provençal hills and wild botanicals foraged from the same earth — distilled and bottled in small, considered batches.
settings.marquee_text: Small batch · Hand-bottled · Provence, France · Sustainable farming · Cuvée N°7 — Now pouring

settings.heading: Patience, poured into glass.
settings.body_1: Aurore began with a single hectare of old-vine Grenache and a stubborn belief that what's grown slowly tastes better. Six years on, we still bottle by hand, label by lamplight, and ship only when a vintage is ready — never when it's asked for.
settings.body_2: Our gin shares the same soil. Botanicals are foraged within thirty kilometres of the cellar; iris from the dry hills, thyme from the cliffs, citrus from a neighbour's grove.

settings.heading:
From vine
to vessel.
settings.intro: Every bottle passes through four pairs of hands — sometimes only two. We don't outsource. We don't filter what doesn't need filtering. We follow the season's lead.

settings.title: Old-vine fruit.
settings.body: Hand-picked at dawn from south-facing parcels we know plant by plant. No mechanical harvest — never has been.

settings.title: Whole-cluster.
settings.body: Gentle pneumatic press at low pressure. We chase elegance, not extraction. The juice runs pale and bright.

settings.title: Concrete & oak.
settings.body: Aged on fine lees for six months. The gin macerates twice — once cold, once warm — before a single-shot distillation.

settings.title: By hand, by lamplight.
settings.body: Labels applied one at a time, wax-sealed for travel. Each bottle numbered against the run — never above 4,800.

settings.heading:
Cuvée N°7
Provence Rosé 2024
settings.body: Pale salmon. Wild strawberry, white peach, a whisper of sea salt. Drinks like a long evening — slowly, and with intent.

settings.heading: Letters from the cellar.
settings.body: Vintage releases, small-batch drops, and the occasional recipe. Four times a year, no more.
